tool.name: LLM Guard
tool.description: Open source LLM safety-filtering toolkit; the repository was archived in July 2026 and is no longer maintained.
tool.statusNote: Repository archived by the owner on July 9, 2026; the project and its Hugging Face models are no longer under active development.
tool.logoNotes: Official LLM Guard docs-site logo asset from the owner-controlled Protect AI project docs (`assets/logo.png`), post-acquisition.
tool.practitionerNote: Archived: fine as a reference for prompt/output scanner design, but do not start new production dependencies on it; pick a maintained guardrail layer instead.

dataResidency.detail: Self-hosted library; data stays on operator infrastructure.

deployment.detail: Open-source Python library; maintenance mode, no managed service.

auditLogging.detail: No built-in audit log in the OSS library.

soc2.detail: Self-hosted library; certification applies to the operator.

iso27001.detail: Self-hosted library; applies to the operator's ISMS.

iso42001.detail: Self-hosted library; applies to the operator.

euAiAct.detail: OSS safety-filtering library; not itself an AI system.

licenseRisk.detail: MIT — permissive; note maintenance-mode operational risk.
